lernapps.github.io.message:
feat: count where visitors come from, as the origin of the other website only

## Intent

Know where visitors come from, such as a search engine, Moodle, a school website or LinkedIn, without collecting personal data. A full referring address can hold names in its query, so only the website itself may be sent.

## Key changes

- The counter sends the origin of the referring website: no path, no query. A visit from within lernapps.net sends no referrer, so nothing is revealed about an app.
- The privacy notice says so and names browser, operating system, language and country among what GoatCounter derives from the request. Screen size is still not sent.

lernapps.github.io.reason: Turning the counter on stays its own commit, to be merged only once the data processing agreement is in place.
lernapps.github.io.message:
feat: turn the usage counter on (lernapps.goatcounter.com)

## Intent

Start counting the visits of the platform sites with the GoatCounter account.

## Key changes

- The counter's endpoint is lernapps.goatcounter.com.
- The privacy notice now shows its section on the counter, with the updated date.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Merge only once the data processing agreement with GoatCounter is in place. The catalog, docs and tooling sites start counting with it.
